AC9S4I03.wording: follow procedures to make and record observations, including making formal measurements using familiar scaled instruments and using digital tools as appropriate

AC9S4I03_E1.wording: identifying animals in field locations using procedures such as direct or virtual observation, call or scat identification or pitfall traps

AC9S4I03_E2.wording: using appropriate equipment to make and record observations, such as digital cameras, video, voice recorders and familiar scaled instruments with appropriate increments

AC9S4I03_E3.wording: describing how to use rounding up or down when reading scaled instruments, and the effect of the scale size on the accuracy of the measurement

AC9S4I03_E4.wording: constructing tables or graphic organisers to record observations
